purpose: The Stage-5 closure contract: every property Stage 5 must establish, the harness that establishes it on the EXACT Axon + MiCode pair, and the skips that are outside Stage 5. Consumed by scripts/v022_stage5_verify.sh (which executes it) and scripts/release_check.sh --stage v022-stage5 (which checks a receipt against it). For a REQUIRED harness, SKIP and NOT_RUN are failures of Stage-5 certification. This profile does NOT redefine AXON_HARNESS_STRICT; repository-wide strict qualification keeps its own meaning.

harnesses.establishes: Axon-side exact tests for every Stage-5 registry row (G03/G08/G10/G11/G13/G28/G32), B256 adapter negotiation, G3 intake join, and the Fabric omissions regression

Real MiCode <-> real Axon: B268 policy consumption and single-owner refusal, B269 episode export/intake, G3 (real MiCode -> real axon-fabric -> real interpreter -> real axon-loop intake) and B256 (real MiCode negotiating with the real cortex-policy-adapter before any model call). Discriminates: a pre-G3 MiCode (0f5329f8) fails every G3 assertion; a lazily negotiating MiCode (f926dbf8) fails 9/11 B256 assertions.
MiCode halves of B256 (negotiation), B261 (WorkspaceVersion vector), the -0 cross-implementation rule, and G3 (the Fabric acceptance-check client's refusal paths)
B268 single policy-adoption owner (TWO_POLICY_ADOPTION_OWNERS) and policy/context refusals on the real MiCode binary
The MiCode workspace suite at its accepted baseline (0 failures). pytest is a PREREQUISITE, not an optional: its absence fails this harness rather than skipping tests that need it.
